title: Lantern and Regiment
author: Theo Sterling
blurb: Mirabel Vane, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
